description: This Java class 'UtilHtml' provides utility methods for HTML content validation, parsing, theme folder identification, and logging. It includes methods to validate HTML fragments with Jsoup, check for unclosed tags with StAX XML parser, retrieve theme folder names, and log warnings related to HTML processing.

classes.name: UtilHtml
classes.description: A utility class for HTML validation, parsing, theme folder management, and logging within the Apache OFBiz framework.

methods.name: validateHtmlFragmentWithJSoup
methods.description: Validates an HTML fragment and returns a list of parse errors if any exist.

methods.name: hasUnclosedTag
methods.description: Checks for unclosed tags in HTML content by parsing XML and returns a list of errors detected.

methods.name: getVisualThemeFolderNamesToExempt
methods.description: Retrieves the list of theme folder names that should be exempted, based on theme and plugin XML files.

methods.name: logHtmlWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message related to HTML content parsing issues.
